attributes.definition: Incoming request size in bytes as read from the Content-Length HTTP request header.

attributes.definition: Incoming request content-type as read from the HTTP request header Content-Type. Example value: application/octet-stream.
attributes.label: request.headers.contentType
attributes.name: request.headers.contentType

attributes.definition: The unique ID (a randomly generated string) used to identify a single request as it crosses inter- and intra- process boundaries. This ID allows the linking of spans in a distributed trace. Included when distributed tracing is enabled.
attributes.label: trace.id

attributes.definition: The duration of the transaction, equivalent to duration.

attributes.definition: A unique ID (a randomly-generated string) used to identify a single request as it crosses application boundaries. If distributed tracing is enabled, this will be reported as traceId.

attributes.definition: The type of the transaction. For example: Web or Background (non-web).

attributes.definition: Provides a more specific level of detail about the transaction than transactionType. Example: Controller or Custom.
attributes.label: transactionSubType

attributes.definition: The sum of all async components' duration, in seconds. An async component is a method or function where there is no instrumented encapsulating method or function.
attributes.label: totalTime
attributes.name: totalTime

attributes.definition: Indicates whether this event was sampled for inclusion in a distributed trace. Only present when distributed tracing is enabled.
attributes.label: sampled
attributes.name: sampled

attributes.definition: The HTTP response code associated with the transaction.

attributes.definition: The HTTP request method used. Example values: POST, GET.

attributes.definition: If a distributed trace payload was received, the guid of this parent transaction.

attributes.label: parent.transportType
attributes.name: parent.transportType

attributes.definition: When distributed tracing is enabled and a payload is received, the difference in time between the timestamp given for when the payload was sent and the moment it was processed.

attributes.definition: (Ruby and Java agents only) The total time spent in garbage collection during this transaction, in seconds.

attributes.definition: The database response time in seconds.

attributes.definition: The number of database calls made by this transaction.

attributes.definition: The application name set in the New Relic agent configuration.
attributes.label: appName
attributes.name: appName

attributes.definition: The unique numeric identifier assigned by New Relic for the service/app that generated the transaction.
attributes.label: appId
attributes.name: appId

attributes.definition: The unique ID of the account associated with the service/application where the Transaction was created.
attributes.label: accountId
attributes.name: accountId

eventDefinitions.definition: A transaction is a logical unit of work in a software application, such as HTTP requests, SQL queries, background processes, message queue activity, etc. The Transaction event includes information about the app, database calls, the duration of the transaction, and any errors that may occur.
eventDefinitions.label: Transaction
eventDefinitions.name: Transaction
